study.question: Can auxiliary tasks learn private positional residuals around a click-trained shared prior, retaining complementary forward transfer while preventing harmful auxiliary backward updates? Observation: shared/primary click AUC0.6654978909 versus shared/joint0.6640206391, a0.0014772518 difference. Yet shared/primary improves auxiliary AUCs0.85880438/0.87078641/0.88304931 versus task/joint0.85752541/0.86968251/0.88165799. Incumbent task/primary click0.6655420609 is only0.0000441700 above shared/primary. These full-validation, single-seed observations motivate asymmetric transfer, not a proven mechanism.
study.hypothesis: A click positional route can supply an event-specific prior to rare auxiliary tasks, whose own position rows learn deviations. Blocking only auxiliary gradients into the click donor may retain click quality while permitting auxiliary adaptation. Let p_t(e)=<W_t,phi(e)> with the inherited collapsed-feedback/match/rank basis. Click uses p_click(e); auxiliaries use p_t(e)+stopgrad(p_click(e)) in the candidate, with live donation as a backward control. Replace p_click(e) by its masked history mean for the alignment control. This is a prospective training-information-flow hypothesis. Event donation is an exact forward reparameterization of task-private positional rows, not increased representational capacity or verified novelty.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary lines250-277 establish target-conditioned unnormalized local-activation pooling, retained by inheritance. New intervention concerns only task sharing/backward ownership of the existing positional correction; this is not exact DIN reproduction.

Pinned benchmark implementation lines204-219 concatenates specific/shared task hubs and iterates aggregation/broadcast; lines241-313 describe learned multi-view aggregation and gated broadcasts. This candidate instead shares a scalar input-derived positional logit from click to auxiliary residuals with explicit stop-gradient ownership; no token hubs or attention broadcasts adopted. Original INFNet paper content is unavailable in the authorized archive, so original-method equivalence and priority remain unverified.

Section2.3 describes task-aware hubs, heterogeneous token interaction and competitive filtering. These are context for alternatives, not evidence of effectiveness here. The four variants only alter inherited positional routing, with no new token-interaction network.

inherited_components: Read-only DIN adapted field embeddings, target-conditioned local activation and four towers, with the incumbent128/32 selector and128/64 towers.
Primary-owned selector and primary item tables; jointly learned context and private auxiliary item/action tables.
Forty-dimensional resolved target-match/count/fraction evidence, event gate, local-collapsed bilinear gate, event rank bases exp(-rank/{1,4,16,64}), and320 existing positional entries.
Live self gate and click coefficient-L1-preserving redistribution; auxiliary full gates; frozen four-task host recipe and scoring.
study.proposed_difference: Replace position task-sharing switches with auxiliary residual donation. All four cells activate auxiliary private position rows already allocated. A click donor is either event aligned or a masked per-history signed mean; only donor gradients are joint or primary-owned. Defaults/literal CONFIG define each standalone variant. The none donor identity mode bridges the existing task/joint implementation for host checks only. No parameter, reset, RNG draw, label access, new time input or training-loss change is introduced. The incumbent task/primary had inactive auxiliary position rows; use existing task/joint and shared/primary as component controls rather than crediting their differences to one factor.
predictions: At equal weights event_primary and event_joint predictions must agree, as must mean_primary and mean_joint. Auxiliary-only loss gradients into the click positional row must be zero under primary ownership and may be nonzero under joint ownership. Auxiliary residual gradients remain active in all cells. Click-only losses must give identical positional-row gradients between the paired ownership variants.

Primary-owned event residual donation should preserve click AUC relative to closest protected/private references while improving auxiliary mean AUC and/or auxiliary Logloss over shared-only and private-only controls. Selection remains full-population click AUC; auxiliary gains are a separately reported tradeoff.

If transferred event structure is useful beyond a history scalar, event donation should improve auxiliaries over mean donation at matched ownership. If protection generalizes after auxiliary residuals are added, joint donor training should perform worse for click than primary donor training.

No training or scoring is permitted in this propose phase. Host must first verify arbitrary label ordering, fixed-state equality/gradient ownership, auxiliary learning, no-donor equivalence to task/joint, same initial predictions, finite forward/backward under BF16, empty/zero-length/masked histories including holes, padding and current-action invariance, and inherited coefficient-L1 behavior. Parameter count should remain56,351,704; report measured wall/GPU time, memory, throughput and latency instead of inferring efficiency from parameter count.
falsifiers: A source/API/masking/gradient check failure invalidates the implementation before scientific interpretation; missing torch/data in this coding workspace is an execution limitation, not evidence against the hypothesis.

If residual donation fails to improve auxiliary performance over both protected shared-only and private-only references at comparable click performance, the complementary residual hypothesis is unsupported in this implementation.
If joint gradients perform at least as well as primary ownership after adding residuals, protection does not transfer from the earlier shared-only architecture.
If mean donors match/beat event donors, event alignment is unsupported; if event donors win, saturation/variance remain alternative explanations until a distribution-matched control.

A sole small validation improvement does not establish a mechanism, reproducibility, statistical significance, production validity or priority; stronger conclusions require reserved paired repetitions and user-cluster uncertainty when available.
alternative_explanations: Reviewed negative branches: learned auxiliary representation transfer g3-r0006-learned_aux_transfer click0.65925750 underperformed its parent private tables0.66016383 and fixed-self control0.66004193. Gate auxiliary donation g3-r0012-redistrib_aux_live0.66304711 underperformed self-live0.66334880. Neither failure rules out a protected forward click-to-auxiliary prior in a different route.

History-composition conditioning g3-r0013-composition_resolved0.66350724 underperformed local-collapsed0.66371005; event position g3-r0014-position_collapsed0.66550816 outperformed marginal position0.66380238. These contrasts motivated retaining local event rank, but do not establish the proposed transfer mechanism.

Auxiliary residual capacity can explain improvement over shared-only. Event residual has the same function class as private task rows, but its Jacobian, effective step sizes, optimizer states and clipping can explain differences without semantic transfer.

Joint donor gradients differ in both magnitude and direction; any ownership effect is not direct evidence of gradient conflict. Mean-donor control matches signed donor mean only, not variance or gate saturation.

Single-seed recipe, fixed seed rather than seed independence, prior adaptive validation search and unmeasured user-cluster uncertainty limit causal confidence. The few empty-history examples and rare positives require counts and insufficient-slice marking.

Official offline feedback may be immature at prediction time, and auxiliary labels are24h user/category/brand matches rather than ad-specific conversions. Publisher static snapshots and whole-window vocabulary assumptions limit deployment interpretation.

The coding workspace supplies source/receipts but no raw data or torch execution. Existing successful matched-protocol receipts and verified baseline/incumbent hashes establish the inherited starting point; fresh data-digest, loader, tensor and training checks are host responsibilities. No new local readiness execution or raw-data audit is claimed.
